_comment: The GitHub issue forms ErgoptiPlus opens (Debug > Report a bug, Suggest a feature). `file` names a form of .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/ and every id in `fields` must be one of its fields (tools/test/test-issue-templates.cjs); `fields` is also the prefill order, and the last field is the first one cut when the URL is too long. The repository comes from _shared/modules/updater/defaults.json, never from here. max_url_bytes bounds the percent-encoded URL: GitHub answers 414 a little above 8 KB, and a prefill is a convenience, so it is cut field by field rather than refused. Built by _shared/ui/issue_link.js and its Lua and AHK ports.
